registry_name: Product outbound market analysis seed Source Packs

execution_boundary.boundary_note: Source Pack 只是来源入口目录；Query Plan 只是下一步怎么查。未打开来源前不生成事实、税费、认证、物流、趋势、价格或市场判断。

source_packs.display_name: 美国目的国准入来源入口包
source_packs.pack_boundary_note: 仅为美国准入来源入口目录；是否适用任何要求必须在本轮打开主管来源并核对产品条件后再写。

source_packs.display_name: 美国进口税费来源入口包
source_packs.pack_boundary_note: 仅为美国税费来源入口目录；候选税号、税则入口和裁定入口不能替代最终归类、最终税额或报关专业确认。

source_packs.display_name: 美国原产地证明 / COO 来源入口包
source_packs.pack_boundary_note: 仅为美国 COO / proof of origin 相关来源入口目录；目标国规则、优惠原产地、原产地标识和用户文件状态必须分开核验。

source_packs.display_name: 中国出口国监管来源入口包
source_packs.pack_boundary_note: 仅在出口申报国确认为中国时用于采集；默认中国必须对用户可见可改，不能由品牌语言、制造线索或卖方所在地自动套用。 本 Pack 仅为来源入口目录，不含事实结论。

source_packs.display_name: 越南出口国监管来源入口包
source_packs.pack_boundary_note: 仅在出口申报国确认为越南时用于采集；越南制造、工厂地址或证书线索不能自动变成越南出口申报国或具体起运港。 本 Pack 仅为来源入口目录，不含事实结论。

source_packs.display_name: 中国/越南至美国物流与预申报来源入口包
source_packs.jurisdiction_name: China/Vietnam to United States trade lanes
source_packs.pack_boundary_note: 只提供物流、港口、承运和预申报入口；运输时间必须按本轮打开来源和货物条件写成常见口径，不能承诺交期或猜起运港。 本 Pack 仅为来源入口目录，不含事实结论。

source_packs.display_name: 美国市场信号来源入口包
source_packs.pack_boundary_note: 市场信号只作客观参考入口；Google Trends 是相对搜索兴趣，平台价是挂牌参考，公开报告需记录口径和日期。 本 Pack 仅为来源入口目录，不含事实结论。

source_packs.display_name: 锂电产品通用规则来源入口包
source_packs.jurisdiction_name: Lithium battery cross-border transport rule locators
source_packs.pack_boundary_note: 锂电通用入口不能替代目的国、出口国、承运人和具体文件核验；缺 SDS / UN38.3 / 包装资料时只能列待确认。 本 Pack 仅为来源入口目录，不含事实结论。

source_packs.display_name: 纺织服装通用规则来源入口包
source_packs.pack_boundary_note: 网页成分、款式和洗护只能作为产品资料线索；实物标签、BOM 和最终归类必须另行核验。 本 Pack 仅为来源入口目录，不含事实结论。

source_packs.display_name: 产品原始资料来源入口包
source_packs.jurisdiction_name: User-provided product URLs, PDFs, TDS, SDS, BOM, labels and manufacturer pages
source_packs.pack_boundary_note: 产品原始资料可支持产品字段和资料缺口清单；不能自动证明海关原产地、最终 HS、目的国合规或运输可行性。 本 Pack 仅为来源入口目录，不含事实结论。

source_entries.source_name: US regulator product safety and business guidance locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 入口覆盖范围按产品类别变化；打开后仍需核对适用范围。

source_entries.source_name: US textile labeling guidance locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 网页产品信息不能替代实物标签照片或 BOM。

source_entries.source_name: US hazardous materials transport regulation locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 规则入口不是承运人接收确认；需按单独/随设备/装入设备和包装状态核验。

source_entries.source_name: USITC HTS official tariff locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 官方税则入口仍需确认 10 位统计后缀、实物条件、原产国和附加税适用性。

source_entries.source_name: CBP CROSS customs rulings locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 裁定只适用特定描述；不同产品不能直接套用。

source_entries.source_name: US trade remedy and additional duty locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 需按具体清单、日期、原产地和产品范围核对。

source_entries.source_name: CBP origin and rulings locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 入口不能替代本次产品/订单的海关裁定。

source_entries.source_name: US trade agreement rules of origin locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 优惠原产地规则不能泛化为普通进口文件要求。

source_entries.source_name: US country-of-origin marking locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 原产地标识与 COO / proof of origin 文件要求必须分列。

source_entries.source_name: China customs export declaration locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 出口申报规则必须按出口申报国和现行监管条件核验。

source_entries.source_name: China export control and commerce authority locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 未命中搜索不等于不受管制；需按清单和最终用途核验。

source_entries.source_name: China inspection and quarantine / commodity inspection locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 商检/检验检疫按 HS、产品、目的国和批次文件核验。

source_entries.source_name: Vietnam customs export declaration locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 只有出口申报国确认为越南后才用于执行。

source_entries.source_name: Vietnam trade ministry export regulation locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 需按越南官方来源和产品范围核验。

source_entries.source_name: Vietnam standards and quality locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 本入口不能把本地标准或登记文件升级为国际运输文件状态。

source_entries.source_name: Public port, carrier, freight forwarder schedule guidance locator
source_entries.landing_url_or_locator_template: official port / carrier / airline / express public locator by route and cargo condition
source_entries.known_limitations: 公开服务说明只能作为常见入口；真实订舱、截关和费用需业务确认。

source_entries.source_name: Destination customs and carrier pre-filing locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 海关预申报节点不能替代船司截单或货代操作要求。

source_entries.source_name: Dangerous goods carrier acceptance locator
source_entries.landing_url_or_locator_template: carrier dangerous-goods acceptance / booking guidance locator by UN scenario
source_entries.known_limitations: 承运条件随船司、航司、快递和货物文件变化；不能由入口判断可运输。

source_entries.source_name: Google Trends locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 只能作为相对搜索兴趣入口，不能代表销量。

source_entries.source_name: Public B2B/B2C platform price locator
source_entries.landing_url_or_locator_template: public platform search locator by product specification and region
source_entries.known_limitations: 挂牌价需按规格和税运费条件对齐，不能写成成交价。

source_entries.source_name: Public market statistics, association, and report locator
source_entries.landing_url_or_locator_template: public statistics / association / report locator by product and country
source_entries.known_limitations: 公开摘要必须记录口径和日期，不能替代付费报告正文。

source_entries.source_name: Commodity exchange and index locator
source_entries.landing_url_or_locator_template: public exchange / commodity index locator by commodity, contract, unit and delivery region
source_entries.known_limitations: 期货/指数只能作价格背景，不能替代现货出口成交价。

source_entries.source_name: Public holiday and seasonal calendar locator
source_entries.landing_url_or_locator_template: official holiday calendar / retail season locator by country and product occasion
source_entries.known_limitations: 节假日只是销售窗口参考，不等于采购需求。

source_entries.source_name: Recent external factor locator
source_entries.landing_url_or_locator_template: official notices / reputable news locator for ports, war, disasters, strikes, sanctions, macro events
source_entries.known_limitations: 只记录有日期的外部因素，不做政治或投资判断。

source_entries.source_name: Lithium battery transport rule locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 需配合具体 SDS、UN38.3、包装和承运规则核验。

source_entries.source_name: Air transport lithium battery rule locator
source_entries.landing_url_or_locator_template: IATA / airline / express lithium battery guidance locator by UN scenario
source_entries.known_limitations: 航空/快递规则高度依赖承运人和货物文件。

source_entries.source_name: Textile and apparel classification reference locator
source_entries.landing_url_or_locator_template: official tariff notes / customs ruling / textile classification locator by garment type and fiber
source_entries.known_limitations: 只能辅助归类沟通；最终归类需官方税则/裁定和实物条件。

source_entries.source_name: Manufacturer or user-provided product document locator
source_entries.landing_url_or_locator_template: user-provided URL/PDF or manufacturer product page locator
source_entries.known_limitations: 资料必须匹配型号/版本；外部模型总结和文件名不能替代可见内容。

observation_requirements.required_visible_content: visible official page text for product category
observation_requirements.creates_evidence_card_when: source opened, visible section recorded, date/applicability/limits captured
observation_requirements.blocks_evidence_card_when: only search snippet; source blocked; product scope mismatch

observation_requirements.required_locator: URL + CFR/section or carrier page locator
observation_requirements.required_visible_content: visible transport rule text for scenario
observation_requirements.creates_evidence_card_when: source opened and scenario-specific limits captured
observation_requirements.blocks_evidence_card_when: only snippet; missing SDS/UN38.3/package status; scenario unclear

observation_requirements.required_locator: official tariff query URL or reproducible query parameters
observation_requirements.required_visible_content: visible tariff hierarchy, notes and rate columns
required_limitations: candidate classification only until product and broker/customs confirmation
observation_requirements.creates_evidence_card_when: official tariff entry opened with query parameters and limitations
observation_requirements.blocks_evidence_card_when: candidate code too broad; no origin; source not opened

observation_requirements.required_visible_content: visible ruling text with product description
required_limitations: does not transfer automatically to different SKU
observation_requirements.creates_evidence_card_when: ruling opened and product comparability limits captured
observation_requirements.blocks_evidence_card_when: summary only; product mismatch; ruling inaccessible

observation_requirements.required_visible_content: visible rule, accepted document type or scenario
required_limitations: target rule separate from user material status
observation_requirements.creates_evidence_card_when: official/authority source opened and scenario + limitations captured
observation_requirements.blocks_evidence_card_when: only search summary; preferential rule generalized; marking/document conflated

required_limitations: export country does not decide destination compliance
observation_requirements.creates_evidence_card_when: official source opened with product/HS scope and limitations
observation_requirements.blocks_evidence_card_when: export country unconfirmed; only snippet; product scope mismatch

observation_requirements.required_visible_content: visible route, node, cargo condition and time-basis content
observation_requirements.creates_evidence_card_when: source opened, cargo condition and date captured
observation_requirements.blocks_evidence_card_when: only snippet; missing cargo condition; promised transit phrasing

observation_requirements.required_visible_content: visible pre-filing timing and responsible party content
required_limitations: customs filing separate from carrier cut-off
observation_requirements.creates_evidence_card_when: official or carrier source opened with timing and limits

observation_requirements.required_locator: Google Trends URL, screenshot or export locator
required_limitations: relative search interest is not sales, GMV or import volume
observation_requirements.creates_evidence_card_when: Trends page/export visible with keyword/region/time range
observation_requirements.blocks_evidence_card_when: only search summary; metric converted to sales

observation_requirements.required_locator: public listing URL or reproducible platform search locator
required_limitations: listing price is not transaction/wholesale target
observation_requirements.creates_evidence_card_when: listing opened with comparable spec and limitations
observation_requirements.blocks_evidence_card_when: no spec/currency/date; price upgraded to target or transaction

observation_requirements.required_visible_content: visible public metric or abstract with methodology

required_limitations: index/futures is background, not spot export transaction

observation_requirements.required_locator: official notice or reputable news URL + event date
observation_requirements.required_visible_content: visible dated event and affected chain
observation_requirements.creates_evidence_card_when: source opened and event date + affected chain captured
observation_requirements.blocks_evidence_card_when: no date; no source; judgment language

required_limitations: does not prove customs origin or final compliance by itself
observation_requirements.creates_evidence_card_when: document opened/readable, model matched, page/section/limits captured
observation_requirements.blocks_evidence_card_when: file name only; model mismatch; external model summary only

route_rules.rule_name: 目标销售国家/地区为 United States
route_rules.boundary_note: 目标国美国只触发来源目录，不确认税费、合规或销售表现。

route_rules.rule_name: 出口申报国确认为 China
route_rules.boundary_note: 默认或用户指定中国必须可见可改；不能由原产国自动推导。

route_rules.rule_name: 出口申报国确认为 Vietnam
route_rules.boundary_note: 只有出口申报国确认为越南时才进入越南出口来源计划。

route_rules.rule_name: 只有中国原产/Production 线索，出口申报国未知
route_rules.boundary_note: Production / Made in 只能触发原始资料核验，不自动触发出口结论。

route_rules.rule_name: 只有越南制造/装配线索，出口申报国未知
route_rules.boundary_note: 越南制造线索不等于越南出口申报国或具体起运港。

route_rules.rule_name: 产品触发标签包含 lithium_battery
route_rules.boundary_note: 锂电标签只决定要查 SDS、UN38.3、包装和承运入口，不判断运输可行。

route_rules.rule_name: 产品触发标签包含 textile 或 apparel
route_rules.boundary_note: 纺织标签只决定要查实物标签、BOM、成分和归类入口。

route_rules.rule_name: 产品触发标签包含 bulk_cargo、breakbulk、roro、heavy_lift 或 oversize
route_rules.boundary_note: 散杂/RoRo/超限只触发物流和市场来源入口；不承诺船型、舱位、港口可操作。

route_rules.rule_name: 产品触发标签包含 food、fresh_produce、flower、tea 或 plant_material
route_rules.boundary_note: 农食/鲜品只触发检疫、冷链和准入入口，不写可进口。

route_rules.rule_name: 有产品名称、型号、用户 URL 或文件
route_rules.boundary_note: 产品原始资料入口只能形成资料核验计划。
候选税号只决定查官方税则/原产地规则，不决定归类或税额。

route_rules.rule_name: 用户询问 COO / proof of origin 或目标国+原产国+HS 条件足够
route_rules.boundary_note: COO 查询组只查目标国规则；用户材料状态另列。
